caseNameFull: Riss & Co., Inc. v. United States
attorneys: Wong Yang Sung v. McGrath, 339 U. S. 33. A. Alvis Layne, Jr. argued the cause for appellant. With him on the brief were John B. Gage and Wendell Berge. Daniel W. Knowlton argued the cause and filed a brief for the Interstate Commerce Commission, appellee.

opinions.text: Appeal from the United States District Court for the Western District of Missouri. Per Curiam: The judgment is reversed.
